brief: Neat gable-roofed frame granary about 26 ft by 32 ft in freshly painted white lap siding with white corner boards and downspouts, on a low limestone foundation. Each gable end has a big white plank sliding door on an overhead track and a small four-pane window high in the peak; inside, a central drive runs between triple grain bays with wood floors on each side. Dark grey asphalt shingle roof, an old cast-iron hand pump on a concrete pad in front and mown lawn around it. (Drive-through granary; nearest vocabulary type is frame_machine_shed.)
